description: Run the same logic as `policyseed check`: read previously rendered policies (NN-<slug>.md files) and report which are overdue for their periodic review, based on the last date in each policy's revision history and the intake's review_cadence (Annual 365d, Semi-annual 182d, Quarterly 91d). Paths are on the machine running this server; pass `directory` as an absolute path to the project, since the server's working directory may not be the user's project.

directory.description: Project directory containing intake.yaml and policies/. Defaults to the server's working directory.

intake.description: Optional inline intake instead of reading intake.yaml; only review_cadence and effective_date are used.

intake_path.description: Path to intake.yaml. Relative paths resolve against `directory`. Default "intake.yaml". Ignored if `intake` is given.

policies_dir.description: Directory of rendered policy .md files. Relative paths resolve against `directory`. Default "policies".

name: check_reviews
title: Check policy review dates
